2609.00605.title: Confess What You Know: Forget-Set Misalignment with Model Knowledge in LLM Unlearning
2609.00605.paper_summary: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) often assumes that a pre-defined forget set matches what the model has memorized, but this frequently breaks in realistic privacy settings where the original training data is inaccessible. We term this gap forget-set misalignment and identify two cases. In Under Unlearning, the forget set omits memorized information and leakage persists. In Out-of-Knowledge Unlearning, the algorithm is driven to "forget" knowledge the model never learned, perturbing parameters and degrading utility. Using gradient-level analysis, we show these behaviors arise from misaligned unlearning targets rather than specific optimization choices. We then propose CONfession-to-Forget-Set (CONFS), a data-blind framework that constructs model-aligned forget sets by eliciting and formalizing the model's memorized knowledge. Across synthetic, multimodal, and real-world benchmarks, CONFS approaches Gold-standard performance on several metrics and achieves a competitive forgetting-utility balance, while preserving utility better than other data-blind forget-set constructions.
2609.00605.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）的機器遺忘通常假設預先定義的遺忘集與模型所記憶的內容相匹配，但在原始訓練數據無法訪問的現實隱私環境中，這種假設經常失效。我們將這一差距稱為遺忘集不對齊，並識別出兩種情況。在「未充分遺忘」中，遺忘集省略了記憶的信息，導致信息洩漏持續存在。在「超出知識的遺忘」中，算法被驅使去「遺忘」模型從未學習過的知識，擾動參數並降低效用。通過梯度級別分析，我們顯示這些行為源於不對齊的遺忘目標，而非特定的優化選擇。我們隨後提出了CONfession-to-Forget-Set（CONFS），這是一個數據盲框架，通過引出和形式化模型的記憶知識來構建模型對齊的遺忘集。在合成、多模態和現實世界基準測試中，CONFS在幾個指標上接近金標準性能，並實現了競爭性的遺忘效用平衡，同時比其他數據盲遺忘集構建方法更好地保留效用。
